title: NodeDefensesDown
description: A node's defense HP reached 0, from fire or starvation (CONTRACTS 6; GAMEPLAY 8, COMBAT CB-10; NX-124 part 3): capture of the node can now start. Not emitted for a node that begins at 0 (a NEUTRAL one or one that just changed hands). Individual hits are WeaponImpact; the HUD reads the hp from NodeView.hp_pct.

owner.description: The node's owner at the time.
